callLines.line: 📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.

anchoredLines.line: 🌪️ THE HERALD struck Stonebridge in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Stonebridge answers! Ruth Haddad and Grace Kowalski will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield answers! Peter Nguyen and Zoe Adeyemi will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Ashford REFUSES. they do not trust this coalition with their people. (trust −8 — refusals are remembered.)

🛡️ Kacper steps forward. They will march with the muster, eat from your stores (1000 kcal/day each), and stand in front of THE HERALD. They can die — Haven does not get them back, and the fire will be quieter. Tap again — Haven sends its own.
🛡️ Haven commits its own: Kacper marches with the muster. Not loaned. Not asked-for. Ours. The coalition counts 5 blades against THE HERALD — it needs 10.
Packed: 2 Aid from Thornfield, 3 Foraged food, 2 Fish catch. (3.5 Mcal, 0.7 kg)
